source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: A July 2024 bug showed updateNotifications passed the raw cache to NotificationManager, bypassing date and interaction filtering. All manager updates now go through _updateNotificationManager and its getNotifications result. The regression test uses a future high-priority item and a current lower-priority item to prove the future item stays hidden.
title: Pass only eligible notifications to the display manager
